summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, writing the control only when is_terminal and making no Windows calls; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not run: tests and Black were not executed, per instructions. Nothing committed.
